 News A huge week at home with Melbourne United
 1 Nov
 1
 min read
 Share on social
 Facebook Link 
 Linkedin Link 
 Linkedin Link 
 Linkedin Link 
 Melbourne United is gearing up for a huge week at John Cain Arena, with two home games giving fans two opportunities to get behind the squad.
 United will host the New Zealand Breakers on Monday 2 November before returning to take on the Brisbane Bullets on Saturday 7 November.
 To mark the occasion, fans can access 20% off all remaining tickets to either game , with a special offer available exclusively for these two home fixtures.
 Whether you’re organising a family outing, catching up with mates or looking for a night of live basketball, it’s the perfect opportunity to get along and be part of the atmosphere.
 Spend Melbourne Cup Eve with United 
 Start the week at John Cain Arena as United take on the New Zealand Breakers on Monday 2 November.
 With a 7:30pm tip-off and a public holiday the next day, round up your people and make a night of it. Bring the noise, wear your blue and help United start the week strong at home.
 Monday 2 November | 7:30pm | John Cain Arena 
 Access 20% off tickets: United v NZ Breakers 
 Back it up on Saturday against Brisbane 
 The action continues on Saturday 7 November when the Brisbane Bullets visit John Cain Arena.
 Whether you’re joining us again after Monday or making Saturday your night at the basketball, get ready for live NBL action and entertainment for all ages, with tip-off at 7:30pm.
 Saturday 7 November | 7:30pm | John Cain Arena 
 Access 20% off tickets: United v Brisbane Bullets 
 How to access the offer 
 Choose one game or join us for both. Each game is booked separately, and you must use the dedicated AXS offer link for your chosen fixture above to access the 20% saving.
 This offer applies to all remaining tickets for these two home games only, subject to availability.
